rv.q: It is flavoursome yet familiar, and above all it won’t rot your teeth.
Too static, too visually blaring, too short on tunes, too mechanical, too unimaginative. I have not disliked a whopping show so much since Chitty Chitty Bang Bang.
The glorious new musical at Drury Lane has something crucial over the two fine film versions: a real sense of invention and improvisation.

cn.t: Mixed reviews: critics praise Douglas Hodge's electrifying Wonka and theatrical invention, but some find it visually overwhelming and short on memorable tunes.
